# GreetPrompt — AI Wishing Cards & Scene Prompt Studio

> GreetPrompt (https://greetprompt.com) is a free, real-time AI wishing card creator and creative scene prompt engine running on Cloudflare Workers AI with Meta Llama 3.2 and SDXL Diffusion.

## Overview
GreetPrompt generates personalized, luxury greeting cards (4:5 Portrait, 1080x1350 px) formatted for 1-click WhatsApp sharing, Instagram, and social media. It features a zero-latency client-side vector SVG typography studio with metallic foil gradients (24K Gold, Rose Gold, Platinum Silver) and edge-accelerated AI prompt assistance.

## Key Features & Tools
- **1-Click Card Creation**: Instant personalized greeting cards with custom recipient and sender names.
- **AI Blessing Crafter (Llama 3.2 3B)**: Culturally authentic blessings across 4 tones:
  - *Devotional*: Sacred, reverent shlokas and divine grace (Ganesh Chaturthi, Diwali, Eid, Christmas).
  - *Poetic*: Lyrical rhythm, elegant metaphors, and heartfelt verse.
  - *Cheerful*: Joyful, energetic, and celebratory wishes with festive smiles.
  - *Formal*: Respectful, dignified, and professional greetings for elders and colleagues.
- **AI Scene Prompt Crafter**: Context-aware photographic scene prompts tailored to occasion, cultural sphere, time of day (Sunrise, Morning, Twilight, Night), and atmosphere.
- **Dual-Engine Visuals**:
  - *0ms Instant Curated Presets*: Bundled fine-art backgrounds (Shri Krishna Darshan, Royal Ganesha, Desi Kulhad Chai, Mount Fuji Sakura, Glowing Brass Diyas).
  - *Custom AI Diffusion*: Sub-2-second edge diffusion using `@cf/bytedance/stable-diffusion-xl-lightning` and Ultra HD `@cf/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0`.
- **Live Vector Typography Studio**: Real-time alignment (Left, Center, Right), font size (Compact, Standard, Grand), and metallic foil controls that update in 0ms without re-rendering the background image.

## Supported Occasions
- Ganesh Chaturthi (गणेशोत्सव / Vinayaka Chaturthi)
- Diwali (दीपावली / Deepotsav / Festival of Lights)
- Good Morning (Daily Chai, Sunrise, Sacred Darshan)
- Navratri & Durga Puja (Garba, Dandiya, Divine Shakti)
- Birthdays & Anniversaries (Luxury celebration cakes, champagne bokeh)
- New Year & Milestone Celebrations

## Supported Languages
- Indic: Marathi (मराठी), Hindi (हिन्दी), Gujarati (ગુજરાતી), Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ), Telugu (తెలుగు), Tamil (தமிழ்), Bengali (বাংলা), Hinglish.
- Global: English, Spanish (Español), Portuguese (Português), Arabic (العربية), French (Français), German (Deutsch), Italian (Italiano), Japanese (日本語), Korean (한국어), Chinese (中文).

## Public API Endpoints
- `GET https://greetprompt.com/api/presets`: Returns available cultural spheres, occasions, languages, and curated scenes with edge IP geo-detection.
- `POST https://greetprompt.com/api/ai/message`: Generates tone-aware greetings with Llama 3.2 (`{ occasion, language, tone, recipientName, senderName, seed }`).
- `POST https://greetprompt.com/api/ai/prompt-suggest`: Synthesizes visual scene prompts for text-to-image models (`{ occasion, sphere, timeOfDay, tone, currentPrompt, seed }`).
- `POST https://greetprompt.com/api/generate`: Generates vector SVG card with typography overlay and optional SDXL diffusion.
